parent_policy: observed_admission_completion, not suspended_campaign or either failed generic reentry candidate
evidence: Completed support/readiness/completion/reentry studies retain original raw accounts. The combined parent passes only the necessary pre-2026 screen and still fails original economics. Existing actual-account attribution rejects indiscriminate stop widening. Additional source-18901a4 recorded-state diagnostics show that inverse-stop-risk ranking and removing the volatility penalty have mixed or negative mean matured20-session price excess across pools; those are not executable profits and neither rank change is selected. The current allocator sorts signal scores before funding, grants each fresh name an initial equal slice of stop-risk, then separately completes selected admissions. That sequence need not maximize the funded value of the unchanged scores under the same resources. Test the allocation mechanism directly rather than changing prediction, stops, recovery or nominal risk budgets.
control: The unchanged observed_admission_completion owner with the same construction-time Config and full actual-account lifecycle. A same-source control is necessary for this new comparison, not a redispatch of an old grid.
treatment: Replace only its positive-allocation method before the first observation. Keep the original readiness arrays, score, entry and exit eligibility, actual units, campaign stops, pending protection, quantity declaration, RiskState and completion wrapper. On a close reaching the original positive-allocation path, choose zero, one or two eligible purchase legs jointly. An existing holding can be enlarged only at the parent's original breakout condition; a new leg consumes an actually vacant slot. No sale or forced rotation is introduced.
objective: Maximize sum(original positive Features.score times proposed purchase notional divided by actual NAV). This is a deterministic allocation of existing signal utility, NOT a calibrated return forecast, Kelly guarantee or proof of profitable trades. Enumerate allowed single legs and pairs, then vertices of their two-variable feasible polygon; ties prefer the earlier lexicographic symbol tuple. There is no fitted numerical parameter and no new ranking transformation.
constraints: Use the original two-position support parent with risk_budget0.10. Purchases are bounded simultaneously by min(0.99*actual_cash, risk_cap*NAV-current_marked_holdings), remaining total stop-risk after all actual inventory, original single-name and sector caps, available actual slots, original 0.01*NAV fresh-order and Config.trade_band*NAV held-addition materiality. Stop distance is max(close minus existing/pending/admission stop, 0.02*close). Included purchase legs must satisfy their original minimum; doing nothing is feasible. The support parent's full-account loss budget, not an arbitrary per-new-name preliminary slice, is the authority; the existing completion wrapper already permits residual risk to flow to selected fresh admissions. Do not use projected sale proceeds or enlarge the full-account risk/cash/position limits.
obligations: No allocation on a protected close or after a cap cut, no cancellation of pending exits or economic quantity ceilings, no stop lowering, no alteration of actual-NAV history, no hidden removed security, no changes to costs/next-open/T+1/liquidity/minimum-fill safeguards. Old source modules and frozen contracts remain byte-identical. Initialize the alternative inner allocator once, never replace live state. Save original observations, scores, resource constraints and selected purchases in the source-bound intent trace.
selection: Keep finite_study's existing pre-2026 three-scope worst-deficit/objective/fill ordering and all baselines unchanged. Exactly these two candidates; preserve both raw results. A selected control means the treatment did not establish the necessary improvement. No pool-wise winner stitching, added candidate, retrospective objective edit or waiver.
evaluation: Evaluate the single selected candidate under unchanged full, bull, late-June-through-August, July-August and retrospective2026 windows. Before main delivery the same production candidate still needs all original native references, original pools, actual contributor/industry removals, fixed subsets/sizes, costs/delays, parameter neighborhoods and causal-prefix checks. A finite necessary screen is not original economic acceptance.
verification: two-leg exact feasibility and adversarial greedy counterexample
actual slot accounting and unchanged held inventory
protective reductions and retries take precedence
Config propagation and source-bound trace integrity
limitations: All previously inspected history including2026 remains retrospective. Portfolio opportunity costs and raw failed outcomes must be retained. Adjusted economic units are not a verified actual-share/corporate-action/tax ledger. No private reference source or external strategy implementation is imported.
